Remark
[Dirac measure notation] ↗ thm:poisson-equation-solution-formula 1. ch2:2.2.1-rem-1\group Fundamental Solutions

Distributionally, \[ -\Delta \Phi =\delta _0, \] so $-\Delta (\Phi *f)=f$. The conclusion of subsubsection thm:poisson-equation-solution-formula remains valid under weaker hypotheses on $f$; see \cite{GilbargTrudinger1983}.
